1. A protective cover comprising:a) a collapsible material having a thickness,b) said cover having a surface, and at least one edge portion; andc) programmable magnets encapsulated to said cover at said edge portion.
2. The protective cover according to Claim1configured to cover one of an engine inlet,
and engine exhaust, and a Pitot tube.
3. The protective cover according to Claim1wherein said collapsible material is a fabric.
4. The protective cover according to Claim 3 wherein said fabric is a fire resistant ballistic fabric including antistatic fibers.
5. The protective cover according to Claim 4 wherein the programmable magnets are encapsulated by stitching the fabric around said programmable magnets
6. The protective cover according to Claim 5 wherein the collapsible material thickness is sufficient to prevent the magnetic field strength of the programmable magnets to cause adherence to one another.
7. The protective cover according to Claim 1 wherein at least one of said programmable magnets is programmed to have a magnetic field strength in a portion different from the magnetic field strength in other portions.
8. The protective cover according to Claim l wherein a combination of one or more collapsible material thickness and a magnetic field strength of said programmable magnets enables adherence to an aircraft surface subject to wind loads greater than 40 mph.
9. The protective cover according to Claim 1wherein the programmable magnets have a magnetic field strength sufficient to adhere the protective cover to an aircraft while not causing damage to surface coatings
10. The protective cover according to Claim 9 wherein the programmable magnets have a magnetic field that does not interfere with electronic signals when installed on an aircraft.
